alt: Photo: a young man writing a list of words on a paper card. Text: Your seed phrase is your money. Store it like it.
Chat: Roland, where should I keep my seed phrase? 🤔 Good question. Most people get this wrong, so let's fix it today. First: whoever has those 12 or 24 words has your money. Full stop.
Chat: I took a screenshot so I won't forget it 😅 Please delete it today 🙏🏾 Screenshots sync to the cloud, get backed up, get shared by accident. Never a screenshot.
Chat: Where your seed phrase should NEVER be 🚫 Screenshots or photos, Notes apps, Google Drive, iCloud, email WhatsApp "message to self", Any website or form that asks for it
Chat: But what if "support" asks for it to fix my wallet? That's a scammer. Every single time. No real exchange, wallet or support agent will ever ask for your seed phrase.
Chat: Where it SHOULD be ✅ Written on paper (or stamped on a metal backup), offline. Kept somewhere safe from fire, water and curious visitors. Some people keep two copies in two places.
Chat: Bonus for bigger amounts 🔐 A hardware wallet keeps your keys off your phone and laptop. Your seed phrase is the backup. Guard the paper like cash.
Chat: Your turn 👇 Be honest: where is your seed phrase right now? Paper, screenshot, or "I don't know"? 😅 No judgement. Comment and I'll help you fix it. 💬
